goal: Run comparable quality evaluations across reference models and Buddy while maximizing safe parallelism and preserving reproducibility.

selection.per_task: Choose strong applicable references by capability and modality rather than using one universal winner.

execution.matrix: Use benchmark/task/model matrices where jobs are independent.
execution.parallelism: Maximize safe concurrency subject to runner, provider, rate, hardware, quota and cost constraints.
execution.serialization: Serialize shared mutable fixtures, conflicting resources, and stateful dependent tests.
execution.fail_fast: Use fail-fast for deterministic preflight/configuration failures; retain independent benchmark results when one model/task fails.
execution.sharding: Shard large suites by model, capability, task family and fixture where reproducibility permits.
execution.resume: Resume incomplete shards without relabeling missing results as passes.

evidence: Store raw or appropriately redacted evidence references, aggregate measurements, evaluator type, sample size, and uncertainty where available.
no_paid_calls: The execution framework must support no-call/catalog-only and pre-approved evaluation modes. It must not silently initiate paid model/API usage.
stale_data: Model/version changes invalidate affected comparisons until the relevant suite is rerun.
mastery: Reference-model performance defines a comparison target, not automatic ground truth. Buddy closes a gap only by meeting the benchmark's independent quality and applicable safety/reliability gates.
pages: Publish per-model prospectus, per-capability comparison, measured gaps, performance/efficiency metrics, independence state, evidence timestamp and blockers.
limits: Respect provider licenses, access controls, rate limits, quotas, terms and benchmark permissions. Never bypass restrictions.
